title: On the structure of categorical duality operators
summary: We systematically study categorical duality operators on spin (and anyon) chains with respect to an internal fusion category symmetry C. We parameterize duality operators on the quasi-local algebra in terms of data dependent on the associated quantum cellular automata (QCA) on the symmetric subalgebra $B$. In particular, a QCA $α$ on $B$ defines an invertible C-C bimodule category $M_α$, and the duality operators extending $α$ form a simplex, with extreme points in bijective correspondence with the simple object of $M_α$.
